data.long_meaning: From the Greek name κοσμός (kosmos), meaning 'world' or 'order'. The suffix -ιος (-ios) denotes 'god' or 'divine'. Thus, Kosiso can be translated as 'God's salvation' or 'God of the world'. The name Kosiso carries the meaning “God's salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kosiso usually hope their child will grow to embody god's salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
